passage.label: Thamud denied prophet transgression; most wretched sent forth; messenger Allah Salih said do not harm she-camel Allah prevent drink; denied hamstrung her; Lord brought destruction sin made equal upon all; does not fear consequence

arabicExcerpts.text: فَقَالَ لَهُمۡ رَسُولُ ٱللَّهِ نَاقَةَ ٱللَّهِ وَسُقۡيَٰهَا
فَكَذَّبُوهُ فَعَقَرُوهَا فَدَمۡدَمَ عَلَيۡهِمۡ رَبُّهُم بِذَنۢبِهِمۡ فَسَوَّىٰهَا

mainSubject.label: Thamud's denial through transgression illustrated: their most wretched one sent forth despite the messenger of Allah warning them not to harm the she-camel of Allah or prevent her drink; they denied him and hamstrung her, so their Lord brought down destruction for their sin making it equal upon all of them, and He does not fear the consequence thereof

subordinateSubjects.label: Thamud denied their prophet by reason of their transgression
When the most wretched among them was sent forth
The messenger of Allah warned them about the she-camel of Allah and her drink
They denied him and hamstrung the she-camel
Their Lord brought down destruction for their sin, levelling it upon all, fearing no consequence

commandsAndProhibitions.description: Do not harm the she-camel of Allah or prevent her from her drink.

propheticNarratives.label: Thamud denying their prophet through transgression, hamstringing the she-camel after warning

humanConditionsAndSpiritualStates.label: Most wretched individual acting on behalf of the entire transgressing people
Destruction levelled equally upon all without divine fear of consequence

socialEconomicCivilisational.label: Collective punishment for a collective sin demonstrated through Thamud's annihilation

notes: Wave 13 genuine re-extraction. Boundaries follow the text: P1 closes with the purification-success/corruption-failure binary (10) before the Thamud precedent opens (11); P2 runs through the five-verse narrative of transgression, the she-camel warning, hamstringing, levelled destruction and divine fearlessness (11-15).
